name: roll ball lumbar diagonal
description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the lower back at a diagonal angle. A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your lower back at a diagonal angle while lying on your back with your hips slightly rotated.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep the ball beside the spine, never on it.
Repeat on the other side if needed.
